description.value: Lands End Café is the food and beverage venue inside the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal, the main ferry hub connecting Vancouver Island to the Lower Mainland and the Southern Gulf Islands. Located on the first floor of the terminal building, it serves travellers waiting to board sailings to Tsawwassen, Fulford Harbour, and the Gulf Islands. For touring cyclists, this is a convenient stop before or after a ferry crossing on one of BC's busiest cycling routes.
